program.name: Fighter's Neck
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Fighters train the neck and the grip: bouts, then gentle neck work one day, grip the next.
program.about: Fighters train two things most programs skip: the neck and the grip. Each day starts with bouts, then one day adds gentle neck holds, shrugs and upper-back work, and the other carries, hangs and forearm curls. A strong neck and grip help in the clinch. Neck work stays at half effort. Both later levels add reps.
